title: SG-4 · Add Git-backed contribution storage and API
summary: Git-backed contribution service and world/contribution REST endpoints
description: Context: backend has only player sessions and /healthz. Desired behavior: a contribution service validates and stores each idea as an immutable Markdown file in Git under worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/<round>/contributions/, exposed through world and contribution endpoints. Expected result: players submit ideas safely and concurrently. Why: Git is the single source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: Given an OPEN round, when a valid prompt is POSTed, then a unique Markdown file is written and committed with the bot identity
Given invalid input (length, world, status, limit, rate, duplicate), when submitted, then the request is rejected with a 4xx status and no file is written
Given concurrent submissions, when they run together, then each produces a distinct file
Given a traversal path segment, when used, then it is rejected
All seven listed endpoints respond from the service/world repository

in_scope: backend/internal contribution service, git wrapper, world repository, handlers, wiring
preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Unit tests with mocked Git and clock pass
